_about: What is said in the film 'What we do'. One entry is one breath of narration. `pad` is the silence after it, in seconds, so the picture has time to move. The company name is never spoken (the logo shows it); 'Claude' is spoken through the voice lexicon.

lines.text: Imagine a world where anyone can learn the skills that work asks for. And prove them.
That is what we are building.
Most training ends when the slides end. We think it should end when you can do the work.
So every course is built the same way. Short video lessons. Labs you run yourself, with a guide for every step.
An assistant inside the lesson, that answers from the course. A quiz in every module. And a certificate at the end.
Prepare for a certification. Build a real project. Or learn one useful skill in an hour.
For Claude, there is a guide and a practice exam for every certification.
For your team, we go further. We learn your work, build the course around it, and teach it live.
We can even set up a learning platform for your company. Your courses. Your people. Your name.
And if you want to see it work first, we build a prototype.
Every month, there is the AI Weekend. Two live sessions. Six working demos, built in front of you.
Start with a preview lesson. Nothing to sign up for.
